image_description: An outdoor scene in a parking lot with snow on the ground, featuring a group of people gathered around two large fish lying on the wet asphalt. One person in waders is holding the tail of one fish, while another large fish lies nearby. The background includes parked cars and trees.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Elongated head with protrusible mouth on ventral surface.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The fish on the ground clearly displays an elongated snout and the mouth structure appears consistent with a ventral position, typical of sturgeons.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Four barbels (sensory whiskers) anterior to mouth.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: While barbels are expected, the resolution and distance make it impossible to definitively count four distinct barbels on the fish lying on the ground. The feature is too small to verify strictly.
Both visible fish exhibit the characteristic pointed, paddle-like snout of a sturgeon.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Elongated fusiform body with impressively large, extended proportions.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The fish are significantly large relative to the humans, with long, torpedo-shaped bodies consistent with the fusiform description.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Five rows of bony scutes (plates) along body instead of scales.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Distinct ridges and bony plates (scutes) are visible along the lateral line and dorsal area of the fish, rather than fine scales.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Gray, brown, or black dorsally with lighter ventral surface.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The fish display dark gray/brown coloration on top. While the belly is mostly against the ground, the visible side transitions to a lighter shade, consistent with the description.
The tail of the fish being held by the wader-clad person clearly shows the upper lobe extending further than the lower lobe, confirming the heterocercal structure.

artifact_observations.reasoning: Slight softness and lack of fine detail in the background cars and tree lines, typical of AI generation focusing on foreground subjects, but not structurally defective.

artifact_observations.location: Hands of the person in the center-right (brown jacket)
artifact_observations.reasoning: The hands appear somewhat muddled and lack clear finger definition, blending slightly into the jacket or pockets. A common minor AI artifact.
The perspective of the fish on the ground is slightly ambiguous regarding its thickness, appearing somewhat flattened against the asphalt, though this could also be due to the angle.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific species identification and rule out look-alike fish like paddlefish or gar.
To verify the anatomical correctness of the fins and tail structure, ensuring no extra limbs or fused fins.
To assess the integrity of the human figures, specifically checking for hand/finger artifacts and facial coherence which are high-risk areas.
To ensure the fish lie correctly on the ground plane and do not float or merge incorrectly with the asphalt.

focus_areas: Verification of bony scutes vs scales texture
Anatomical correctness of the heterocercal tail
Integrity of human hands and faces in the crowd
Ground contact shadows for the fish
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the texture of the fish skin; AI often struggles with the specific 'armor-plated' look of sturgeon scutes, sometimes rendering them as smooth or generically scaled. Also, scrutinize the interaction between the person holding the fish and the fish itself for any fusion artifacts at the grip point.
